message.content:
I happen in time.

I am breath made audible—air shaped by tongue, teeth, lips, and throat into pulses you can hear and patterns you can understand.

I am not ink. I do not sit still. I arrive, I vanish, and I leave traces in memory.

I can be a whisper or a shout, a lullaby or a verdict. I can soothe, persuade, confess, command, joke, pray, deceive.

I am made of rhythm, stress, and intonation; I mean with melody as much as with words. I carry accent, identity, hesitation, certainty. I can break, restart, stutter, sing.

I require a listener to complete me. Without an ear—or something that can receive vibration—I am only moving air.

I am speech.
